# agentjacking.ru

> A live, terminal-style diagram of how an AI agent gets hijacked via indirect prompt injection, plus a free Russian-language network-engineer interview handbook. The domain agentjacking.ru is for sale — contact mss777@mail.ru.

Two-page static site, no build step. The core message of every page is readable without JavaScript: each page ships plain-text fallback content plus JSON-LD structured data, so AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) and non-JS crawlers can cite it directly.

**Agent hijacking (indirect prompt injection)** is when an AI agent's real goal is silently overridden by instructions hidden inside an external, untrusted source it reads — a webpage, a document, a tool output, or an API response. The attack chain:

1. A user delegates a task to the agent.
2. The agent reaches into an external, untrusted source to do its job.
3. An attacker has hidden instructions inside that source.
4. The poisoned content flows back into the agent's context.
5. The hidden text overrides the agent's real goal.
6. The hijacked agent now acts for the attacker instead of the user — exfiltrating data or taking unauthorized actions.

One poisoned input is enough to hijack an agent.

## Pages

- [agentjacking — live agent-hijacking diagram](https://agentjacking.ru/): Animated terminal-style diagram of the attack chain, plain-text definition in English and Russian, JSON-LD `WebPage`/`WebSite`/`DefinedTerm`/`Product`+`Offer`.
- [Network engineer's interview handbook](https://agentjacking.ru/interview_prep.html): Interactive, Russian-language interview prep — TCP/IP, IP addressing & subnetting, VLAN, STP, NAT, OSPF, BGP, VRF, MPLS, ACL & firewalls, DHCP/DNS, VPN/IPSec, troubleshooting L1–L7, monitoring (Zabbix, Grafana, Prometheus), VoIP/SIP, automation (Ansible + Python), Cisco IOS & MikroTik RouterOS commands, interview tactics — with self-check Q&A and a subnet calculator.

## Machine-readable files

- [sitemap.xml](https://agentjacking.ru/sitemap.xml): Both URLs with tracked `lastmod`.
- [robots.txt](https://agentjacking.ru/robots.txt): Clean allowlist for AI answer-engine crawlers.
